name: Guild Rivalry
description: Tensions between the Shadow Guild and Forge Legion threaten to boil over. Diplomacy is required.

narrative.intro:
The tavern falls silent as you enter. On one side, scarred smiths of the Forge Legion nurse their ales with murderous glares. On the other, hooded figures from the Shadow Guild return the sentiment with cold calculation.

In the center, a table lies overturned, cards scattered - and blood on the floor. Both sides claim the other cheated. One wrong word could ignite a guild war.

Both groups look to you, the neutral Emissary, to settle this.

choices.text: Examine the cards for evidence of cheating
Appeal to guild honor and shared history
Propose a different contest to settle the dispute

A.text: Your careful examination reveals the truth: a THIRD party planted marked cards to frame the Shadow Guild! A pickpocket from neither guild, hoping to profit from the chaos. Both sides unite briefly to track down the real culprit, and you're rewarded by both guilds for your detective work.

B.text:
"Do you not remember the Battle of Cinderpeak?" you ask. "Where Legion steel protected Shadow scouts, and Shadow intel saved Legion supply lines?" The room grows quiet as you recount the history of cooperation. Grudgingly, both sides stand down and shake hands.

The guild masters later send their personal thanks - and generous rewards.

C.text:
You propose an arm-wrestling contest instead. It's absurd enough to break the tension, and after a Legion smith defeats a Shadow operative, both sides laugh it off. The crisis is averted, though neither side is fully satisfied.

You receive modest thanks for your creative solution.

guild_historian.name: Guild Historian
guild_historian.description: Use knowledge of history to resolve conflict

lore_connection: The six guilds of Emberholm have a long and complicated history. Though they work together to maintain the realm, old rivalries never truly die - they merely smolder.
